text:
NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author posted two screenshots in a comment and said they "solved this one". There was no new push, so the code is unchanged since the feedback.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | The AI-policy feedback is not addressed: the comment doesn't say the author understands and tested the change, and nothing changed in the code or description. |
| ⚠️  | The screenshots are only in a comment. The PR description still has the "[Upload your screenshot or video here]" placeholder. |
| ℹ️  | Open PR #39758 touches the same two files for the same issue and is waiting on review, so a triager may want to decide which one to pursue. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to address the AI policy and move the screenshots into the description (optionally mention #39758).

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots! Please read our [AI policy](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html#ai-use-policy-and-guidelines), then explain in your own words what the change does and how you tested it. Also put the screenshots in the PR description, replacing the placeholder text. Note that #39758 is an open PR for the same issue touching the same files.
```
